model_assumptions.early_deletion_fee_basis: prorated remaining minimum-storage days of the CURRENT class, at the current class storage rate, on its billable size; charged as a one-time migration cost, only when moving; the minimum-duration clock anchors at the object's transition INTO its current class when known (current_class_since), else at upload

recency_weighting.formula: weight = 0.5 ** (days_since_last_access / half_life_days); 1.0 when the document has no observed downloads

model_assumptions.restore_latency_modeled: informational only: retrieval_time_hours is reported per tier and for the recommendation, but does not gate selection

intelligent_tiering.storage_rate_blend: homogeneous-Poisson access model over the horizon: fraction of days in the Archive-Instant tier = exp(-lambda * 90 / 365), in the Infrequent tier = exp(-lambda * 30 / 365) - exp(-lambda * 90 / 365), rest Frequent, where lambda = the recency-attenuated expected annual downloads
intelligent_tiering.objects_below_min_size: objects smaller than 128 KB are stored in the Frequent tier, are never monitored (no monitoring fee) and never tier down, so their modeled rate is the Frequent rate with zero monitoring fee
intelligent_tiering.monitoring_fee: the monitoring/automation fee applies per object-month ONLY to objects 128 KB and larger
intelligent_tiering.archive_and_deep_archive_tiers: bucket-level Archive Access / Deep Archive Access tiers (90/180-day access minima, restore latency) are NOT modeled; the blend covers Frequent/Infrequent/Archive-Instant only, all of which are instant-retrieval
intelligent_tiering.transition_in_fee: lifecycle transitions INTO Intelligent-Tiering bill a $0.01 / 1,000 transition request (usagetype S3-INTTransition)
intelligent_tiering.early_deletion: Intelligent-Tiering has no minimum storage duration and no retrieval fees between its tiers
